content_sections.heading: About NCM
content_sections.text: The National Commission for Minorities is a Government of India body with its office at Block-14, 1st Floor, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. NCM issued the circular for this engagement on 6 November 2026, and the Department of Personnel & Training (CS.I Division) circulated it to retired CSS officers through the DoPT website with an Office Memorandum (No.21/7/2023-CS.I (Coord.)) dated 16 November 2026. NCM describes the engagement as a fee-based consultancy that does not amount to an appointment for employment or a job, and it does not confer any right to regular appointment in Government service.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open to retired officers/officials of the Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Body or Statutory Body, preferably from the Accounts/Audit cadre, who have retired from a post in Pay Level-6 and above of the 7th CPC or equivalent pay scale. Bachelor's degree in Commerce or equivalent. At least five years of practical experience in handling Cash and Accounts, Pay and Allowances, Pension, Budget, Audit and other financial matters in a Government Ministry/Department. Well conversant with GFR, DFPR, Pension Rules, PFMS and other relevant financial rules, regulations and procedures. Working knowledge of computers, particularly MS Word, MS Excel and other MS Office applications, along with familiarity with Government office procedures, including noting and drafting in e-office. Should be in good health and physically and mentally fit to discharge the assigned duties effectively. The applicant should not be more than 62 years of age on the last date of receipt of the application, i.e. on 27 November 2026. The applicant should not have a criminal record or any criminal case pending against him/her in any court. An undertaking to this effect must be given with the application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration is as per the guidelines in Department of Expenditure O.M No.3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, i.e. a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, and Government's instructions issued from time to time on the subject. The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract; there will be no annual increment or percentage increase. A fixed amount as Transport Allowance, as drawn at the time of retirement/superannuation on the last pay drawn, will be paid without Dearness Allowance. TA/DA on official tour, if any, may be allowed as per the entitlement at the time of retirement. For travel outside Delhi for work, NCM shall arrange travel and accommodation as per Central Government Rules. No other allowances such as HRA, residential accommodation or tuition fee reimbursement will be admissible, and there is no separate monthly allowance. No other facilities such as residential telephone, residential accommodation, CGHS and medical reimbursement or transport facilities will be given. Income Tax or any other tax will be deducted at source; NCM will issue TDS Certificate(s). The engagement is on a short-term contract, initially for six months, which may be further extended depending upon the requirement of the Commission and the performance review of the Consultant. It is purely contractual and shall not amount to employment on regular service or re-employment. Leave is allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service; leave cannot be accumulated beyond the calendar year. Working hours are the same as those of regular Government employees in NCM. No extra remuneration is allowed for work beyond office hours or on Saturdays/Sundays/Gazetted Holidays; compensatory leave is at the discretion of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCM Consultant (Accountant)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application strictly as per the format given at Annexure-II of the notice, with a photograph. Attach a CV and relevant documents, including a copy of the PPO (pension received/emoluments drawn before retirement) and a copy of the last pay drawn before retirement. Attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications (Matriculation and above). Complete the self-undertaking regarding criminal antecedents and sign the declaration in the form. Send the application through speed post to The Under Secretary, National Commission for Minorities, Block-14, 1st Floor, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003, or by e-mail to [email protected] . Make sure the application reaches NCM by 27 November 2026; incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. Application in the Annexure-II format with photograph CV Copy of PPO / pension received / emoluments drawn before retirement Copy of last pay drawn before retirement Self-attested copies of educational qualifications (Matriculation and above) Self-undertaking regarding criminal antecedents The form also asks for the post applied for, whether retired from Central Government or PSU or PSU Bank, name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, nationality, present and permanent addresses, mobile and e-mail, last post held with the organisation, pay level/grade pay of the last post, references, and professional experience (organisation, post held and period of service).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection of the Consultant will be done on the basis of a personal interview. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview, and the short-listed candidate will be considered for engagement as per the functional requirements of the Commission. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview. At the interview, short-listed candidates must produce their bio-data and certificates in original for verification. The decision of the Competent Authority on selection will be final, and no correspondence will be entertained. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Consultant (Accountant) at the National Commission for Minorities, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NCM Consultant (Accountant) post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach NCM by 27 November 2026; late or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the NCM Consultant (Accountant) post?
faq.answer: Retired officers/officials of the Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Body or Statutory Body who retired from Pay Level-6 and above of the 7th CPC or equivalent, with a Bachelor's degree in Commerce or equivalent and at least five years of practical Government financial work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NCM Consultant (Accountant) post?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be more than 62 years of age on 27 November 2026, the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NCM Consultant (Accountant)?
faq.answer: The Consultant gets a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, plus the Transport Allowance drawn at retirement without Dearness Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NCM Consultant (Accountant) post?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-II application with CV and relevant documents to The Under Secretary, National Commission for Minorities, Block-14, 1st Floor, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003 by speed post, or by e-mail to [email protected], by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCM Consultant (Accountant)?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of a personal interview, to which only short-listed candidates will be called with their bio-data and original certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NCM Consultant (Accountant) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for six months, and may be extended depending on the Commission's requirement and the Consultant's performance review.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid to the NCM Consultant (Accountant)?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no other allowances such as HRA, residential accommodation or tuition fee reimbursement will be admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the NCM interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview.
